name: Database connectivity
description: Open and close a connection using the configured database secret.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: Slow connection budget
description: Allow a longer connection timeout for a remote database.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: Three-stage promotion
description: Check develop -> preprod -> main, including delay, conflict and outside-flow checks.

credentials.requirement: Existing GIT_SECRET with provider endpoint and read access to the specified repository or project.

notes: The branches must exist. The GIT_SECRET must match the Git provider and endpoint.

name: Two-stage promotion
description: Compare release -> main without the deployment-delay check.

credentials.requirement: Existing GIT_SECRET with provider endpoint and read access to the specified repository or project.

name: Latest main pipeline
description: Inspect the latest pipeline that actually ran for main.

credentials.requirement: Existing GIT_SECRET with provider endpoint and read access to the specified repository or project.

notes: Use a GitLab GIT_SECRET with read_api access. Child pipelines from the same project are included by the implementation.

name: Multiple branches with time limits
description: Check main and release, warn for long active runs and stale pipeline execution.

credentials.requirement: Existing GIT_SECRET with provider endpoint and read access to the specified repository or project.

name: Public HTTPS certificate
description: Warn 30 days before the certificate expires.

name: Custom TLS port
description: Inspect a custom port with a 60-day warning threshold and hostname verification.
notes: Replace the example host with your reachable service.

name: google connectivity
description: Check the built-in Internet endpoint.

name: cloudflare connectivity
description: Check the built-in Internet endpoint.

name: RKE2 kube-proxy certificates
description: Read every node's RKE2 client-kube-proxy.crt through its existing pod; one failing node warns globally.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

notes: The KUBECONFIG needs node/pod read and pods/exec permissions in kube-system. The path and CN remain fixed.

name: Custom pod layout
description: Use a different label selector and container with a 60-day warning threshold.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

notes: Matching pods must still mount /var/lib/rancher/rke2/agent/client-kube-proxy.crt with CN=system:kube-proxy.

name: Deployment health and restarts
description: Check rollout health and accumulated container restarts for one workload.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

notes: The identity needs read access to the workload and related pods; Deployment restart tracking also reads ReplicaSets.

name: StatefulSet health and restarts
description: Check rollout health and accumulated container restarts for one workload.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

notes: The identity needs read access to the workload and related pods; Deployment restart tracking also reads ReplicaSets.

name: DaemonSet health and restarts
description: Check rollout health and accumulated container restarts for one workload.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

notes: The identity needs read access to the workload and related pods; Deployment restart tracking also reads ReplicaSets.

name: Deployment health only
description: Check rollout state without pod or ReplicaSet restart queries.

credentials.requirement: Existing self-contained KUBECONFIG secret. Its API server must be reachable by the STANDARD worker.

name: Chromium page checks
description: Check page text and final URL in Chromium.

text.steps:
QUERY h1
CHECK TEXT Example Domain
CHECK URL http://app.example.test/

notes: Requires a PLAYWRIGHT worker. Replace the illustrative URL with a reachable application page containing a visible h1 whose text is Example Domain.

name: Three-browser page checks
description: Run the same assertions in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

text.steps:
QUERY h1
CHECK TEXT Example Domain

notes: Requires a PLAYWRIGHT worker with all three browsers installed. Replace the illustrative URL with a reachable application page containing a visible h1 whose text is Example Domain.

name: PIPE execution observer
description: Observe terminal history of an existing resource without executing it.

resourceId.requirement: Search an existing PIPE resource, then set textValue to its positive ID as decimal text.

notes: This backend-evaluated observer cannot be run as an ordinary worker template.

name: PROCEDURE execution observer
description: Observe terminal history of an existing resource without executing it.

resourceId.requirement: Search an existing PROCEDURE resource, then set textValue to its positive ID as decimal text.

notes: This backend-evaluated observer cannot be run as an ordinary worker template.

name: HOOK execution observer
description: Observe terminal history of an existing resource without executing it.

resourceId.requirement: Search an existing HOOK resource, then set textValue to its positive ID as decimal text.

notes: This backend-evaluated observer cannot be run as an ordinary worker template.

name: Daily reminder
description: Produce a reminder on the daily schedule.
notes: The outer alert cron must still be configured. Internal cron uses the server time zone.

name: Monthly reminder
description: Produce a reminder at 09:00 on the first day of each month.

name: Status and explanation
description: Read one PostgreSQL row containing a status and detail.

text.sql: SELECT 'WARN' AS status, 'Maintenance window' AS detail

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: Parameterized status
description: Bind a positional SQL argument and map its derived status.

text.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ? > 10 THEN 'WARN' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END AS status

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: Low stock
description: Warn when the selected numeric value falls below ten.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: High queue count
description: Warn when the selected numeric value exceeds ten.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

name: Watch rows with binary snapshot
description: Track additions, removals and changes using a writable binary configuration.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

snapshot.requirement: Existing writable BINARY configuration dedicated to this alert; an empty binary payload initializes the first snapshot.

notes: Use a separate snapshot binding per alert. Execution may write the updated snapshot.

name: Detailed diff with binary secret
description: Keep the snapshot in a writable binary secret and include row details in the result.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for a reachable PostgreSQL database with read-only SELECT access.

snapshot.requirement: Existing writable BINARY secret dedicated to this alert.

notes: Detailed results may expose selected query columns; select only data appropriate for alert results.

name: HTTPS TCP port
description: Check that the TCP port accepts a connection, without an application-level request.

name: Database TCP port
description: Check a database listener with a longer timeout.
notes: Replace the host with your reachable database listener.

name: Read health JSON
description: Request a health endpoint and verify the JSON status field.

name: JSON POST with protected headers
description: Send JSON and obtain authorization headers from a secret binding.

headersOverrideJson.requirement: Existing STRING or EXPRESSION secret resolving to a JSON array of header strings. Do not expose its authorization value.

notes: POST can change remote state. Use an endpoint intended for this operation.

name: Plain SQL backup
description: Return a SQL backup artifact.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for PostgreSQL with backup privileges and the correct engine.

notes: Requires the corresponding database client in the STANDARD worker and a reachable PostgreSQL instance.

name: Gzip backup with configured file name
description: Return a compressed SQL artifact, with its logical name read from configuration.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for PostgreSQL with backup privileges and the correct engine.

fileName.requirement: Existing STRING or EXPRESSION configuration resolving to a logical file name without directories.

name: Plain SQL backup
description: Return a SQL backup artifact.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for MariaDB with backup privileges and the correct engine.

notes: Requires the corresponding database client in the STANDARD worker and a reachable MariaDB instance.

name: Gzip backup with configured file name
description: Return a compressed SQL artifact, with its logical name read from configuration.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET for MariaDB with backup privileges and the correct engine.

fileName.requirement: Existing STRING or EXPRESSION configuration resolving to a logical file name without directories.

name: Schema export
description: Export the APP schema to a Data Pump artifact.

credentials.requirement: Existing Oracle DB_SECRET. The login needs Data Pump privileges and the directory must be accessible to the Oracle server.

notes: DATA_PUMP_DIR must exist on the database server. Default cleanup deletes only the files created by this export.

name: Full export retained on server
description: Produce a compressed full export and retain generated server files.

credentials.requirement: Existing Oracle DB_SECRET. The login needs Data Pump privileges and the directory must be accessible to the Oracle server.

notes: Full exports require the corresponding Oracle privileges. METADATA_ONLY works without data compression; use ALL or DATA_ONLY only when supported and licensed by the Oracle installation.

name: Single-file native backup
description: Return one native .bak artifact.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET with engine SQL_SERVER. The server must permit BACKUP DATABASE and OPENROWSET(BULK) for the backup files.

notes: The server backup directory must be allowed by SQL_SERVER_BACKUP_ALLOWED_DIRECTORIES on the worker. Native backup files are created on the database server before download.

name: Striped native backup
description: Return a zip containing four backup stripes.

credentials.requirement: Existing DB_SECRET with engine SQL_SERVER. The server must permit BACKUP DATABASE and OPENROWSET(BULK) for the backup files.

notes: Stripes permit each OPENROWSET download to stay below the per-file limit. Set an allowed serverBackupDirectory if the server default is not appropriate.

name: Basic token exchange
description: POST with HTTP Basic authentication and extract /access_token.

credentials.requirement: Existing USERNAME_PASSWORD secret for the token endpoint account.

notes: The endpoint must implement this Basic-auth token exchange. The result contains a protected token and must remain redacted.

name: OAuth password grant and client ID
description: Request a token using the password grant and client_id in the body.

credentials.requirement: Existing USERNAME_PASSWORD secret for the token endpoint account.

notes: Only use a provider/client explicitly configured for this grant; this is not an Alertify login shortcut.

name: OAuth confidential client
description: Use a separate client credential secret for HTTP Basic client authentication.

credentials.requirement: Existing USERNAME_PASSWORD secret for the token endpoint account.

clientCredentials.requirement: Existing USERNAME_PASSWORD secret with the OAuth client ID as username and client secret as password.

name: Standard TOTP
description: Generate a six-digit SHA1 code with a 30-second period.

secret.requirement: Existing STRING secret containing the account's Base32 TOTP seed.

notes: The algorithm, digit count and period must match the enrolled account. The generated code is sensitive.

name: Eight-digit SHA256 TOTP
description: Use the alternative TOTP parameters required by an enrolled account.

secret.requirement: Existing STRING secret with a Base32 seed enrolled using SHA256, 8 digits and a 60-second period.

name: Invoke a pipe
description: Execute an existing pipe through a procedure binding.

pipe.requirement: Existing pipe ID returned by alertify_template_binding_candidates. Inspect its steps before authorizing execution.

notes: Execution can trigger every side effect defined by the referenced pipe.

name: Copy binary configuration to NFSv4
description: Copy a bound binary resource to a file on an NFS export.

input.requirement: Existing BINARY configuration containing the file to copy.

notes: The export must be reachable and authorized for the worker; the worker needs its NFS helper. Existing files are not overwritten by default.

name: Copy binary secret with NFSv3
description: Copy a binary secret and explicitly allow replacing the target file.

input.requirement: Existing BINARY secret containing the file to copy.

notes: Execution writes the destination and can overwrite an existing file. Pipe artifact inputs are a separate execution-context path.

name: Public console value
description: Write a non-sensitive test value to the worker console.
notes: Use only non-sensitive values with this development template.

name: Copy to writable configuration
description: Copy a literal to an explicitly writable configuration binding.

writableValue.requirement: Existing writable STRING configuration dedicated to this development test.

notes: Execution writes the referenced configuration.

name: Copy protected value
description: Copy from one secret into a separate writable secret without exposing its result.

sourceValue.requirement: Existing STRING secret used as the input.

writableValue.requirement: Separate existing writable STRING secret used as the destination.

notes: Execution writes the destination secret. Its writable flag must already be authorized.
